typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sPrevBusDay as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCTION_DT as timestamp,
		BR_BRANCH_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM as string,
		TRADER_CD as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		GL_COMPANY_CD as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_AU_CD as string,
		GL_PRODUCT_CD as string,
		GL_INVENTORY_CD as string,
		BAL_IN as string,
		DAILY_BAL_AMT as decimal(18,2),
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT as decimal(18,2),
		UNITCOST_BAL_AMT as string,
		MTM_BAL_AMT as string,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as timestamp,
		YEAR_END_IND as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(EFFECTIVEDATE = toDate(toString($sPrevBusDay, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of GL_AU_CD} = GL_AU_CD,
		{Copy of client_nbr} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of GL_ACCOUNT_CD} = GL_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_CD} = BR_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_NM} = BR_ACCOUNT_NM,
		{Copy of GL_PRODUCT_CD} = GL_PRODUCT_CD,
		{Copy of GL_INVENTORY_CD} = GL_INVENTORY_CD,
		{Copy of ISO_CURRENCY_CD} = ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		{Copy of BR_BRANCH_CD} = BR_BRANCH_CD,
		{Copy of BAL_IN} = BAL_IN,
		{Copy of trader_cd} = TRADER_CD,
		{Copy of YEAR_END_IND} = YEAR_END_IND,
		{Copy of GL_COMPANY_CD} = GL_COMPANY_CD) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		br_account_nm as string,
		br_account_cd as string,
		iso_currency_cd as string,
		daily_bal_amt as integer,
		br_branch_cd as string,
		gl_account_cd as string,
		gl_inventory_cd as string,
		gl_product_cd as string,
		closing_bal_amt as integer,
		client_nbr as string,
		gl_au_cd as string,
		bal_in as string,
		unitcost_bal_amt as integer,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		mtm_bal_amt as integer,
		gl_company_cd as string,
		year_end_ind as string,
		effectiveDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		trader_cd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		br_account_nm = {Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_NM},
		br_account_cd = {Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_CD},
		iso_currency_cd = {Copy of ISO_CURRENCY_CD},
		daily_bal_amt = DAILY_BAL_AMT,
		br_branch_cd = {Copy of BR_BRANCH_CD},
		gl_account_cd = {Copy of GL_ACCOUNT_CD},
		gl_inventory_cd = {Copy of GL_INVENTORY_CD},
		gl_product_cd = {Copy of GL_PRODUCT_CD},
		closing_bal_amt = CLOSING_BAL_AMT,
		client_nbr = {Copy of client_nbr},
		gl_au_cd = {Copy of GL_AU_CD},
		bal_in = {Copy of BAL_IN},
		unitcost_bal_amt = UNITCOST_BAL_AMT,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP,
		mtm_bal_amt = MTM_BAL_AMT,
		gl_company_cd = {Copy of GL_COMPANY_CD},
		year_end_ind = {Copy of YEAR_END_IND},
		effectiveDate = PRODUCTION_DT,
		trader_cd = {Copy of trader_cd}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
